parsed_output.evidence_bound_reasoning_summary: The packet contains 6 rows, all from source family public_procurement (ted-eu, notices/eforms-contract-and-award resource), describing bounded sets of CONTRACT_NOTICE and CONTRACT_AWARD_NOTICE notices under CPV class 9261. These establish that such notices were published, that stated TOTAL_VALUE amounts at NOTICE scope in EUR differ within bounded sets (e.g. a spread of 15658679.12 across 3 notices, 235017 across 2 notices, 86827200 across 6 notices), and that contracting authorities therefore exist and publish notices carrying stated values. Per eForms BT-161, TOTAL_VALUE includes options and renewals and is not realised spend. Nothing here establishes what is procured beyond the CPV classification, whether any need recurs, whether any actor is dissatisfied, whether any gap in supply exists, whether anybody would pay for a new product, or any driver, channel, or feasibility signal. The narrowest defensible hypothesis is that this population of notice-publishing contracting authorities is worth investigating further as a potential buyer population, nothing more.
